speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Conjunctivitis with Disseminated Infection (Gonococcemia).

The infant is 4 days old, born at term, with a history of maternal gonorrhea, presenting with a 1-day history of generalized rash. While I asked about the rash characteristics initially, the clinical picture strongly suggests disseminated gonococcal infection rather than a benign neonatal rash. I will confirm the diagnosis by ordering blood cultures and Gram stain of the rash lesions.
